guards.body: DECLARE native_agent VARCHAR2(128); governed_intake_required EXCEPTION; n NUMBER; legacy_shared NUMBER; BEGIN native_agent:=SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'); IF native_agent<>'__CX_SCHEMA_OWNER__' THEN IF INSERTING AND :NEW.ENTITY_TYPE='KNOWLEDGE' AND COALESCE(:NEW.VISIBILITY,'?')<>'PRIVATE' THEN RAISE governed_intake_required; END IF; IF UPDATING AND (:OLD.ENTITY_TYPE='KNOWLEDGE' OR :NEW.ENTITY_TYPE='KNOWLEDGE') THEN IF COALESCE(:NEW.ENTITY_TYPE,'?')<>'KNOWLEDGE' OR COALESCE(:NEW.VISIBILITY,'?')<>'PRIVATE' OR COALESCE(:OLD.VISIBILITY,'?')<>'PRIVATE' THEN RAISE governed_intake_required; END IF; END IF; IF (UPDATING OR DELETING) AND :OLD.ENTITY_TYPE='KNOWLEDGE' THEN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO n FROM CX_CONTINUITY_ARTIFACT_REVS r JOIN CX_CONTINUITY_ARTIFACTS a ON a.ARTIFACT_ID=r.ARTIFACT_ID WHERE r.NATIVE_ENTITY_ID=:OLD.ENTITY_ID AND a.FAMILY='KNOWLEDGE'; SELECT COUNT(*) INTO legacy_shared FROM CX_KNOWLEDGE_ACCESS_POLICIES k WHERE k.ENTITY_ID=:OLD.ENTITY_ID AND k.STATUS='ACTIVE' AND k.SCOPE_TYPE<>'PRINCIPAL_PRIVATE'; IF legacy_shared>0 OR n>0 OR (DELETING AND COALESCE(:OLD.VISIBILITY,'?')<>'PRIVATE') THEN RAISE governed_intake_required; END IF; END IF; END IF; END;

DECLARE native_agent VARCHAR2(128); governed_intake_required EXCEPTION; n NUMBER; legacy_shared NUMBER; BEGIN native_agent:=SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'); IF native_agent<>'__CX_SCHEMA_OWNER__' THEN SELECT COUNT(*) INTO n FROM CX_CONTINUITY_ARTIFACT_REVS r JOIN CX_CONTINUITY_ARTIFACTS a ON a.ARTIFACT_ID=r.ARTIFACT_ID WHERE (r.NATIVE_ENTITY_ID=:OLD.ENTITY_ID OR r.NATIVE_ENTITY_ID=:NEW.ENTITY_ID) AND a.FAMILY='KNOWLEDGE'; SELECT COUNT(*) INTO legacy_shared FROM ENTITIES e WHERE e.ENTITY_TYPE='KNOWLEDGE' AND (e.ENTITY_ID=:OLD.ENTITY_ID OR e.ENTITY_ID=:NEW.ENTITY_ID) AND (COALESCE(e.VISIBILITY,'?')<>'PRIVATE' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CX_KNOWLEDGE_ACCESS_POLICIES k WHERE k.ENTITY_ID=e.ENTITY_ID AND k.STATUS='ACTIVE' AND k.SCOPE_TYPE<>'PRINCIPAL_PRIVATE')); IF legacy_shared>0 OR n>0 THEN RAISE governed_intake_required; END IF; END IF; END;

DECLARE native_agent VARCHAR2(128); governed_intake_required EXCEPTION; n NUMBER; BEGIN native_agent:=SYS_CONTEXT('USERENV','SESSION_USER'); IF native_agent<>'__CX_SCHEMA_OWNER__' THEN RAISE governed_intake_required; END IF; END;
